The hostel common room smelled of instant noodles and floor cleaner. Pankaj counted out notes on the carrom board and slid them to a final-year senior, who handed over a pen drive: the fluid mechanics lab report, done.
Uma looked up from her own graph paper. 'You paid for that?'

'My bar is surviving this semester.'

Pankaj turned the pen drive over in his fingers and didn't answer. On the TV, a cricket replay played to nobody.

You asked on the call why I sounded weird about my history essay. Okay, full truth: I paid someone online to write it. 2,500 words, due Monday. I'm reading it now so I can at least answer questions on it.
